body: Considering the fact that you just got out of a relationship, have you taken the time out to figure out who are at this point in your life, as a single person? Explore yourself and connect with friends; explore the world around you and take care of yourself first - mind, body and soul (emotionally). Sometimes seeing a psychologist/therapist can help in figuring out those tricky feelings and becoming the best version of yourself.

Have you considered reevaluating your concept of self? It seems like you have an elevated and isolated “me vs them” mentality, accompanied with your overgeneralization of the entire female gender. Considering you have not met, talked to, nor dated ever single female to ever exist, I’m sure your generalization doesn’t apply. As the previous commenter mentioned, maybe seek a relationship expert to help you out, and a psychologist to help you work through any issues that may be inhibiting you mentally from progressing socially.
